name: Yaya
source:
Yaya is the main character of the story. Her parents were both hunters, and she prides herself on her skills with her spear.

Cheerful and optimistic, Yaya is unfailingly certain that she'll find Koko again.

She is fiercely protective of Aiyana, and will challenge anybody who dares make her uncomfortable - even a powerful witch like Maia.
